description: Stop one of the signed-in user's in-progress experiments (sets it to 'abandoned' — no verdict). A completed or already-abandoned experiment is rejected. Without confirm: true it changes nothing and returns the effect of ending (her W654): show it to the user word for word, then call again with confirm: true once they ask to end it. Requires the user to be signed in (`supstack login`).

confirm.description: Ruling 654: true only after the user has been shown the effect of ending (the text this tool returns without it) and asked to end it

name: supstack_experiment_abandon
